description:
Source: a retrospective over 25 agent sessions (2026-10-18 to 2026-11-11), followed by an adversarial re-check of each claim against origin/develop 4835f5a537.

Problem. Agents acted on doc text that no longer matches the repository, or could not reach an existing runbook from the situation they were in. Each line below was confirmed on origin/develop.

Change (docs only, one PR):
1. AGENTS.md Apple/macOS line: remove the `(release-guide.md)` pointer after `make ci-linux` (the guide no longer mentions it; `make help` describes the target). Reword the mocker clause so it says the local container runtime is `mocker` and that `docker` is absent on the host, keeping the never-CI rule. Sessions read the old wording as 'no container runtime' and skipped live checks.
2. AGENTS.md 'Worktree and change safety': add one sentence. Read and edit tools resolve relative paths against the session directory, usually the primary clone, even after `cd`; pass absolute worktree paths, and read current code from `origin/develop` because the primary clone's files can lag. Link docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md.
3. AGENTS.md 'Verification and close-out': state that `make pr-open` runs the local review, and that absent reviewers are diagnosed with docs/internal/review-gateway-host.md#troubleshooting and never by editing the OMP credential store.
4. AGENTS.md [REMOTE-CLOSEOUT-001] and docs/agent/remote-closeout.md opening paragraph: stop claiming the `make pr-arm-remote` and `make pr-landing-remote` targets do not exist (make/pr-landing.mk defines both). Keep the rule that every PR closes out from a linked worktree; the remaining condition is that `make pr-open` works in cloud sessions. Owner decision 2026-11-11: the exception is not live yet.
5. docs/internal/release-guide.md (three places near the trunk UAT deferral text) and docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md (the trunk UAT row): a release-v2 run defers trunk UAT only when it is not a probe (scripts/trunk_uat.py `_is_probe`, `active_release_runs`).
6. docs/internal/perf-smoke.md: delete the 'Skipping the check' section (no workflow reads `skip-perf-smoke`; perf-smoke.yml is deleted) and change 'both workflows' to nightly-v2.yml.
7. docs/internal/review-v2.md Setup step 2: the `oracle` environment deploys from `develop` and `release/*`, as the same file and scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py already say.
8. docs/internal/soundness-drain.md: one line under the title pointing to merge-queue-governance.md section 6 for post-merge `soundness-review-gap` issues and how to close them.
9. docs/internal/dev-loop-worktrees.md: the remaining 'todo-db MCP server' wording becomes 'tractable'.

Non-goals. No docs/internal index. No per-target pointers for tools `make help` already lists. No edits to historical sections of review-v2.md or to ADRs. tests/README.md lock text is correct and stays. AGENTS.md 'Check CI on a schedule, never in a loop' is owned by pr-arm-wait-mode-20261111.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone, and pass absolute worktree paths to every file tool; stage paths explicitly, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission or skipping the test lock; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or review gate, and never post a stand-in; change only the files this item names, and report anything else as noticed-but-not-touched; re-read every cited file on current origin/develop before editing, because the line numbers here are hints from 2026-11-11 (origin/develop 4835f5a537); close at a merged PR (make pr-open, make pr-arm), and finish this item only after the merge is observed.
